materials.name: Aboleth Mucus
materials.desc: Clear, cold slime that clings to skin in a shimmering film; a coating lets lungs draw breath from water.

materials.name: Aboleth Tentacle
materials.desc: A thick, rubbery limb whose touch leaves skin translucent and clammy. Used in transformation and waterborne curses.

materials.name: Aboleth Brain
materials.desc: A heavy, three-lobed brain that still hums with stolen memories. The heart of mind-control and telepathy magic.

materials.name: Aboleth Eye
materials.desc: A lidless, milky-red orb that seems to watch whoever holds it. Seers grind it into scrying salves.

materials.name: Aboleth Hide
materials.desc: Grey-green slick hide that never quite dries. Makes superb waterproof leather.

materials.name: Aboleth Essence
materials.desc: A dim green murk in the vessel that whispers promises; the prime keystone for enslaving or mind-linking magic.

materials.name: Androsphinx Mane Hair
materials.desc: Coarse golden hair that crackles faintly with holy power. Woven into wards and oath-cords.

materials.name: Androsphinx Larynx
materials.desc: A great ribbed voice-box that still thrums when struck. Fashioned into horns that terrify, deafen and shake stone.

materials.name: Androsphinx Claw
materials.desc: A pale golden talon as long as a dagger that never dulls. Treasured for holy weapons.

materials.name: Androsphinx Tear
materials.desc: A single amber drop that shows glimpses of past and future when held to the eye.

materials.name: Androsphinx Essence
materials.desc: Warm golden light that recites riddles in a whisper; the keystone for divination, time and holy guardian magic.

materials.name: Ankheg Carapace
materials.desc: Glossy brown chitin plates that shrug off acid. Armourers shape them into light, resilient armour.

materials.name: Ankheg Acid Gland
materials.desc: A swollen amber sac of stomach acid that fizzes through leather. Base for acid flasks and etching.

materials.name: Ankheg Mandible
materials.desc: Serrated pincers strong enough to crush a horse's leg; make fine picks and digging tools.

materials.name: Ankheg Meat
materials.desc: Pale, sweet flesh reminiscent of crab. Farmers fry it as revenge.

materials.name: Basilisk Eye
materials.desc: A dull green orb that still turns flesh grey when you meet its reflection. The iconic reagent for petrification.

materials.name: Basilisk Gizzard Stone
materials.desc: Polished pebbles swallowed and turned half-magical in the basilisk's gut. Ground into stoneskin and flesh-to-stone brews.

materials.name: Basilisk Blood
materials.desc: Thick, grit-flecked blood; oddly, alchemists refine it into salves that undo petrification.

materials.name: Basilisk Scales
materials.desc: Stone-grey scales heavy as slate. Sewn into armour that turns blades.

materials.name: Basilisk Fang
materials.desc: A needle-thin fang coated with a mild venom.

materials.name: Basilisk Essence
materials.desc: A heavy, sluggish grey mist that makes the vessel feel like it is turning to stone.

materials.name: Behir Lightning Gland
materials.desc: A crackling blue sac behind the throat that arcs to nearby metal. The keystone of lightning weapons.

materials.name: Behir Scales
materials.desc: Electric-blue scales that tingle to the touch. Armour from them grounds lightning harmlessly.

materials.name: Behir Fang
materials.desc: A curved fang with a faint blue spark trapped inside.

materials.name: Behir Claws
materials.desc: Hooked climbing claws from its many feet; ideal for climbing gear.

materials.name: Behir Essence
materials.desc: A jittering thread of blue-white light that crackles loudly against the glass.

materials.name: Centaur Longbow
materials.desc: A tall, horn-backed bow strung for mounted shooting. Balanced and swift.

materials.name: Centaur Herbal Pouch
materials.desc: A beaded leather pouch of dried plains herbs for poultices and trail-teas.

materials.name: Centaur Quiver
materials.desc: A long quiver of fletched arrows and bright trade beads.

materials.name: Chimera Fire Gland
materials.desc: A sooty, egg-shaped gland from the dragon head; breathes fire when squeezed. Base for fire flasks and flame weapons.

materials.name: Chimera Goat Horn
materials.desc: A twisted ram's horn scorched black at the tips. Makes battering helms and hunting horns.

materials.name: Chimera Lion Mane
materials.desc: Coarse tawny mane that bristles when wolves are near. Worn by warlords to cow their foes.

materials.name: Chimera Dragon Scales
materials.desc: Red-black scales from the draconic neck, warm and fire-proof.

materials.name: Chimera Essence
materials.desc: A snarling, tri-coloured smoke that butts against the glass.

materials.name: Chuul Paralytic Tentacles
materials.desc: A tangle of pale feelers that still twitch; their slime numbs skin instantly. Distilled into paralytic poisons.

materials.name: Chuul Carapace
materials.desc: Heavy mottled shell plates with a nacreous inner surface. Superb for underwater armour.

materials.name: Chuul Pincer
materials.desc: A crushing claw the size of a shield; can be mounted as a grappling weapon.

materials.name: Chuul Antennae
materials.desc: Delicate feelers that twitch toward magic. Used in detect-magic lenses and wands.

materials.name: Chuul Essence
materials.desc: A pearly swirl that drifts toward any enchanted object nearby.

materials.name: Cloaker Hide
materials.desc: A supple black hide that seems to drink lamplight. The ideal base for cloaks of shadow and concealment.

materials.name: Cloaker Moan Sac
materials.desc: A ribbed throat sac that produces a sub-audible groan when squeezed. Makes horns of dread.

materials.name: Cloaker Eyes
materials.desc: Glowing red eyes set like brooch-gems; they see perfectly in pitch dark.

materials.name: Cloaker Tail Spine
materials.desc: A whip-like bony tail tip, black as jet.

materials.name: Cloaker Essence
materials.desc: A flickering dark shape that doubles and blurs inside the vessel.

materials.name: Cockatrice Feathers
materials.desc: Dull, stiff feathers that feel faintly like grit. Used to fletch arrows that slow and stiffen.

materials.name: Cockatrice Beak
materials.desc: A hooked grey beak crusted with mineral residue; its saliva ducts still petrify.

materials.name: Cockatrice Egg
materials.desc: A leathery egg that is cold and heavy as a river stone.

materials.name: Cockatrice Essence
materials.desc: A faint gritty haze that settles like dust on the vessel walls.

materials.name: Darkmantle Darkness Gland
materials.desc: A black, velvety nodule; pinching it releases a puff of unnatural darkness. Used in dark-powder and shadow ink.

materials.name: Darkmantle Mantle
materials.desc: A thin, rubbery skin like a wet umbrella. Makes light-swallowing hoods.

materials.name: Darkmantle Tentacles
materials.desc: Short, rubbery tentacles; chewy but edible if boiled.

materials.name: Death Dog Fangs
materials.desc: Yellowed fangs pitted with rot. Grounds for plague-bane remedies — and plague poisons.

materials.name: Death Dog Saliva
materials.desc: Grey, foul-smelling drool thick with sickness.

materials.name: Death Dog Pelt
materials.desc: Patchy, mangy dun fur; cheap and rather unpleasant.

materials.name: Death Dog Twin Skull
materials.desc: A fused two-headed skull; shamans hang them as wards against ambush.

materials.name: Doppelganger Skin
materials.desc: Grey, rubbery skin that ripples and faintly takes on the colour of whoever holds it. Makes masks and disguise cloaks.

materials.name: Doppelganger Brain
materials.desc: A smooth, almost featureless brain; mind-readers distil surface-thought potions from it.

materials.name: Doppelganger Blood
materials.desc: Colourless blood that takes on the hue of any vessel it's poured into.

materials.name: Doppelganger Essence
materials.desc: A shifting grey mist that forms half-familiar faces.

materials.name: Drider Silk Gland
materials.desc: A pearly spinneret pouch still full of fine grey silk. Spins thread for climbing cords and dark cloaks.

materials.name: Drider Venom
materials.desc: A dark, oily poison from the drider's fangs.

materials.name: Drider Poisoned Blade
materials.desc: A wicked drow longsword with a groove along the fuller still slick with poison.

materials.name: Drider Carapace
materials.desc: Black, glossy chitin from the spider half; light and stiff.

materials.name: Drider Essence
materials.desc: A bitter violet smoke with eight grasping tendrils.

materials.name: Ettercap Silk Gland
materials.desc: A sticky, pale bladder of web-stuff. Spun into snares and trap-lines.

materials.name: Ettercap Venom
materials.desc: A thin, greenish venom from its fangs that sickens and weakens. A cheap, reliable base for blade poisons.

materials.name: Ettercap Webbing
materials.desc: Thick strands scraped from its nest; strong as rope once treated.

materials.name: Gibbering Mouther Tongues
materials.desc: A bundle of twitching tongues that sometimes still mumble. Used in confusion and madness draughts.

materials.name: Gibbering Mouther Eyes
materials.desc: Mismatched eyeballs of every colour; oddly, they see in the dark.

materials.name: Gibbering Mouther Flesh
materials.desc: Doughy flesh that turns the ground to sticky mire when pressed down.

materials.name: Gibbering Mouther Essence
materials.desc: A chattering swirl that sounds like a hundred distant voices.

materials.name: Gorgon Breath Gland
materials.desc: A heavy iron-grey lung sac that exhales a greenish vapour; the keystone for petrifying breath and stone gas.

materials.name: Gorgon Iron Hide
materials.desc: Overlapping plates of living iron; smiths work it into superb heavy armour.

materials.name: Gorgon Horns
materials.desc: Steel-hard horns for trampling charges.

materials.name: Gorgon Essence
materials.desc: A dense green-grey fog that clicks against the glass like pebbles.

materials.name: Grick Beak
materials.desc: A sharp, horn-coloured beak that crushes bone. Carved into picks and war-hooks.

materials.name: Grick Hide
materials.desc: Rough, stone-mottled skin that blends into rock.

materials.name: Grick Tentacles
materials.desc: Four stubby head-tentacles; rubbery bait for cave fishing.

materials.name: Griffon Feathers
materials.desc: Broad golden-brown flight feathers. Fletching and flight charms.

materials.name: Griffon Talons
materials.desc: Hooked eagle talons as long as a finger, built to lift a horse. Set into grappling hooks and gauntlets for an iron grip.

materials.name: Griffon Egg
materials.desc: A speckled egg; hatchlings raised by hand become loyal mounts.

materials.name: Griffon Pelt
materials.desc: Tawny lion pelt with a feathered ruff.

materials.name: Guardian Naga Spit Gland
materials.desc: A golden-green gland holding a burning, spray-ready venom.

materials.name: Guardian Naga Scales
materials.desc: Gold-and-green scales with a gentle shimmer. Woven into holy wards.

materials.name: Guardian Naga Heart
materials.desc: A great, softly glowing heart. Unless blessed and destroyed, the naga may return — some priests keep it in trust.

materials.name: Guardian Naga Essence
materials.desc: A calm golden coil of light that hums like a hymn.

materials.name: Gynosphinx Feather
materials.desc: A wing feather that shows hidden truths when looked through edgewise. Only gifted or shed feathers keep their power.

materials.name: Gynosphinx Eye
materials.desc: A golden eye with a starry iris; seers polish it into lenses of true seeing.

materials.name: Gynosphinx Claw
materials.desc: A pale golden claw marked with tiny glyphs.

materials.name: Gynosphinx Tear
materials.desc: A shimmering drop that shows fleeting visions of the past.

materials.name: Gynosphinx Essence
materials.desc: A spiralling golden mote that murmurs unanswered riddles.

materials.name: Harpy Vocal Cords
materials.desc: Silvery, delicate cords that hum a lingering note when plucked. Strung into luring instruments and charm-songs.

materials.name: Harpy Feathers
materials.desc: Greasy grey-brown feathers that smell of carrion yet thrum faintly when wind crosses them. Fletchers use them for cheap flight charms and luring whistles.

materials.name: Harpy Talons
materials.desc: Filthy hooked talons, sharp as knives and never quite clean. Set into grapnel hooks and cruel hand-claws.

materials.name: Harpy Essence
materials.desc: A pale mist that sings a faint, beguiling tune.

materials.name: Hippogriff Feathers
materials.desc: Long white-and-brown quills. Popular for fletching and feather-fall charms.

materials.name: Hippogriff Hide
materials.desc: Horse-like hide, durable and plain.

materials.name: Hippogriff Meat
materials.desc: Dark, lean meat, like game fowl.

materials.name: Hydra Heart
materials.desc: A huge, multi-chambered heart that keeps beating in the jar. The finest keystone for regeneration magic.

materials.name: Hydra Regenerating Flesh
materials.desc: Glistening flesh that knits back together when cut. Must be seared with fire to stop it budding new heads.

materials.name: Hydra Scales
materials.desc: Slick green-bronze scales that regrow when chipped.

materials.name: Hydra Fangs
materials.desc: Rows of backward-curved fangs; each head offers a handful.

materials.name: Hydra Blood
materials.desc: Dark green blood, both healing and venomous depending on how it's refined.

materials.name: Hydra Essence
materials.desc: A mist that keeps dividing into more tendrils the more you watch it.

materials.name: Kraken Ink
materials.desc: Vast quantities of jet-black ink that swallow light entirely. The ultimate scribing medium for storm and sea spells.

materials.name: Kraken Beak
materials.desc: A black, shipwrecking beak as large as a cart. Carved into weapons that split hulls.

materials.name: Kraken Tentacle
materials.desc: A single sucker-lined limb as long as a ship's mast. Its grip is unbreakable.

materials.name: Kraken Storm Organ
materials.desc: A pulsing blue organ near the brain that crackles like a sea squall. The keystone of storm magic.

materials.name: Kraken Eye
materials.desc: A barrel-sized eye that sees through black water; seers polish its lens for deep scrying.

materials.name: Kraken Hide
materials.desc: Mottled red-grey hide that changes colour slowly after death.

materials.name: Kraken Essence
materials.desc: A roiling miniature storm that batters the vessel walls.

materials.name: Lamia Claws
materials.desc: Elegant, gilded claws whose touch clouds the mind.

materials.name: Lamia Tongue
materials.desc: A sweet-scented tongue used in potions of persuasion and glamour.

materials.name: Lamia Pelt
materials.desc: A sleek golden lion pelt, warm and luxurious, faintly perfumed even after tanning. Made into rich mantles and rugs for the vain.

materials.name: Lamia Heart
materials.desc: A heart whose outline seems to shift in lamplight, never quite the same shape twice. Illusionists and charm-brewers render it into glamours.

materials.name: Lamia Essence
materials.desc: A seductive, perfumed shimmer that shows you what you desire.

materials.name: Manticore Tail Spikes
materials.desc: Iron-hard spikes the length of a forearm. Fletchers fashion them into brutal arrowheads and darts.

materials.name: Manticore Wing Membrane
materials.desc: A leathery, bat-like wing membrane veined with dark blood vessels. Stretched over frames for gliding cloaks and flight charms.

materials.name: Manticore Mane
materials.desc: A dark, matted lion's mane that reeks of old blood. Worn as a mantle, it makes onlookers flinch; fear-charms use it.

materials.name: Manticore Teeth
materials.desc: Triple rows of disturbingly human teeth set in a lion's jaw. Strung as grisly trophies or set into serrated clubs.

materials.name: Medusa Head
materials.desc: The whole severed head, snake-hair still twitching. Its gaze petrifies for a short time after death.

materials.name: Medusa Eyes
materials.desc: Glittering green eyes with slit pupils. The keystone of petrifying weapons and stone-gaze wands.

materials.name: Medusa Snake-Hair Venom
materials.desc: A glittering venom from the hair-snakes that numbs and stiffens flesh.

materials.name: Medusa Snake Hair
materials.desc: Dried serpent-locks that retain a faint hiss.

materials.name: Medusa Essence
materials.desc: A green mist with slit-pupilled eyes that seem to watch you.

materials.name: Merrow Harpoon
materials.desc: A barbed, coral-crusted harpoon with a braided kelp line.

materials.name: Merrow Scales
materials.desc: Rough, green scales like rusted chain.

materials.name: Merrow Tusks
materials.desc: Jagged tusks stained dark from demonic rites.

materials.name: Mimic Adhesive
materials.desc: A clear, overwhelmingly sticky glue. The go-to reagent for sovereign glues and binding traps.

materials.name: Mimic Pseudopod
materials.desc: A piece of shapeshifting flesh that slowly drifts into the shape it's pressed against.

materials.name: Mimic Teeth
materials.desc: Splinter-like teeth disguised as wood.

materials.name: Mimic Essence
materials.desc: A sticky mist that shapes itself into the vessel's form.

materials.name: Minotaur Horns
materials.desc: Massive, spiralled horns that always seem to point toward home. Carved into compasses and battering helms.

materials.name: Minotaur Hide
materials.desc: Thick, black bovine hide scarred by a thousand labyrinth walls. Tans into heavy leather for charging harness and hide armour.

materials.name: Minotaur Heart
materials.desc: A muscular heart that still thrums with rage; used in potions of charging and wayfinding.

materials.name: Minotaur Essence
materials.desc: A red mist that paces restless paths inside the glass.

materials.name: Otyugh Bile
materials.desc: A foul-smelling fluid that neutralises rot and toxins. Distilled into disease-resistance tonics.

materials.name: Otyugh Tentacles
materials.desc: Spiked, grasping tentacles; its sensory stalk carries a faint telepathic hum.

materials.name: Otyugh Hide
materials.desc: Rough, pitted leathery hide that sickness never seems to take root in. Tanned into grim but disease-proof gloves and aprons.

materials.name: Otyugh Teeth
materials.desc: Filthy fangs crusted with sickness.

materials.name: Otyugh Essence
materials.desc: A greenish murk that seems strangely clean at its heart.

materials.name: Owlbear Feathers
materials.desc: Soft, barred feathers that muffle sound. Fletched into silent arrows.

materials.name: Owlbear Pelt
materials.desc: A great pelt of fur merging into feathers around the neck. Makes rugged cloaks.

materials.name: Owlbear Beak
materials.desc: A hooked, thick beak capable of crushing bone. Hafted as a war-pick head or mounted as a hunter's proudest trophy.

materials.name: Owlbear Claws
materials.desc: Thick, curved bear claws.

materials.name: Owlbear Egg
materials.desc: A large mottled egg; hatchlings can be raised as ferocious companions.

materials.name: Phase Spider Silk
materials.desc: Faintly translucent silk that flickers between planes when you look at it sideways. Woven into blink-cloaks and portal cords.

materials.name: Phase Spider Venom
materials.desc: A shimmering, clear venom that seems to be slightly out of step with the vial holding it. Poisoners prize it for blade venoms that bite hard.

materials.name: Phase Spider Eyes
materials.desc: Clustered eyes that still see across the planar veil.

materials.name: Phase Spider Legs
materials.desc: Long, faintly translucent legs with hooked, sure-gripping tips. Cut into climbing spikes and light, strong struts.

materials.name: Phase Spider Essence
materials.desc: A flickering spark that keeps vanishing and reappearing in the vessel.

materials.name: Purple Worm Venom
materials.desc: A thick, violet poison that burns through flesh. Poisoners' most coveted prize.

materials.name: Purple Worm Stinger
materials.desc: A barbed, sword-length stinger still grooved with venom channels.

materials.name: Purple Worm Gullet
materials.desc: A vast, acid-resistant throat lining that swallows almost anything. The basis of bags of devouring and portable holds.

materials.name: Purple Worm Hide
materials.desc: Tough, rippling purple hide that shrugs off stone.

materials.name: Purple Worm Teeth
materials.desc: Huge serrated teeth ringing its maw, perfect for digging picks.

materials.name: Purple Worm Essence
materials.desc: A heavy purple haze that coils and bores at the glass.

materials.name: Remorhaz Heat Gland
materials.desc: A searing orange organ that stays hot for days after death. Keystone for fire-resistance and warming charms.

materials.name: Remorhaz Carapace
materials.desc: Ruby-streaked chitin plates that never fully cool. Makes armour that keeps its wearer warm in blizzards.

materials.name: Remorhaz Mandibles
materials.desc: Heavy, heat-scarred mandibles that cut through ice.

materials.name: Remorhaz Essence
materials.desc: A searing orange glow that fogs and heats the vessel.

materials.name: Roc Feather
materials.desc: A flight feather as long as a man. Keystone for flying carpets, brooms and giant-size charms.

materials.name: Roc Talons
materials.desc: Talons the size of scythes.

materials.name: Roc Egg
materials.desc: A giant speckled egg as large as a cart wheel. Hatchlings can be raised as mounts.

materials.name: Roc Beak
materials.desc: A hooked beak large enough to split a horse.

materials.name: Roc Essence
materials.desc: A gusting wind that makes the vessel feel impossibly light.

materials.name: Roper Strands
materials.desc: Long, sticky tendrils that weaken whoever they grip. Used in binding ropes and strength-draining poisons.

materials.name: Roper Gizzard Stones
materials.desc: Gems and odd stones swallowed with prey, polished smooth.

materials.name: Roper Hide
materials.desc: Knobbly, stone-textured hide the colour of cave rock. Draped over a hunter or a door, it vanishes against any cavern wall.

materials.name: Roper Essence
materials.desc: A grey mist that clings to anything it touches.

materials.name: Rust Monster Antennae
materials.desc: Feathery antennae that corrode metal on contact. Used to make rust-bane oils.

materials.name: Rust Monster Carapace
materials.desc: Russet plates that metal cannot scratch.

materials.name: Rust Monster Gut
materials.desc: A gut full of rust and half-dissolved metal.

materials.name: Rust Monster Essence
materials.desc: A red, flaky mist that corrodes metal near the vessel.

materials.name: Spirit Naga Venom
materials.desc: A dark, oily venom that drains life. The keystone of necrotic poisons.

materials.name: Spirit Naga Scales
materials.desc: Black scales rimmed with silver.

materials.name: Spirit Naga Heart
materials.desc: A cold heart that pulses with dark will; if not destroyed the naga may return.

materials.name: Spirit Naga Essence
materials.desc: A black coil that hisses and strikes at the glass.

materials.name: Tarrasque Carapace
materials.desc: An enormous shell plate with a mirror-like sheen that turns aside spells. Keystone for antimagic and spell-reflecting shields.

materials.name: Tarrasque Heart
materials.desc: A house-sized heart that keeps beating for weeks. Keystone for unmatched regeneration.

materials.name: Tarrasque Horns
materials.desc: Colossal horns that shatter fortress walls.

materials.name: Tarrasque Claws
materials.desc: Talon-like claws as long as a spear.

materials.name: Tarrasque Teeth
materials.desc: Dagger-long teeth by the dozen.

materials.name: Tarrasque Blood
materials.desc: Dark red blood that knits flesh before your eyes.

materials.name: Tarrasque Essence
materials.desc: A crushing wave of mute fury that cracks the vessel it's stored in.

materials.name: Winter Wolf Pelt
materials.desc: White fur that blends perfectly into snow. Makes cold-resistance cloaks and white camouflage.

materials.name: Winter Wolf Frost Gland
materials.desc: A frosted sac behind the throat that still breathes freezing air when squeezed. The heart of frost-breath draughts and cold-snap flasks.

materials.name: Winter Wolf Fangs
materials.desc: White fangs that are always cold to the touch and rime over at night. Set into daggers and charms that bite with frost.

materials.name: Winter Wolf Essence
materials.desc: A swirl of white frost that howls faintly.

materials.name: Worg Pelt
materials.desc: Rough, dark fur that smells of blood. Goblin warlords wear them.

materials.name: Worg Fangs
materials.desc: Yellowed fangs; charms against ambush.

materials.name: Worg Meat
materials.desc: Stringy, gamy meat.

monsters.name: Aboleth
monsters.blurb: An ancient, slime-sheathed fish-thing of vast memory; its mucus and brain are coveted by alchemists who dare the deep lakes.

harvest.note: Scrape it into sealed jars while the body is still wet; once dry it turns to useless flakes.
Handle only with gloves: raw contact risks the skin-sloughing disease the aboleth carries.
Anyone who touches it bare-handed must shrug off a flood of alien memories (Wisdom save).
It escapes with the last breath: hold an Essence Vessel ready and stopper it within a minute.

monsters.name: Androsphinx
monsters.blurb: A lion-bodied, man-faced guardian of sacred secrets; to slay one is sacrilege, so most of its gifts come freely shed or honourably earned.

harvest.note: Only hair given willingly or shed at its lair keeps its virtue; hair cut from a slain sphinx is inert.
Only from a sphinx that died beyond saving; taking it from one killed without cause invites a curse from the gods it serves.
A sphinx sheds tears only when moved by great grief or truth; they cannot be taken by force.
A faint shimmer over the body marks it. Catch it in an Essence Vessel within a minute.

monsters.name: Ankheg
monsters.blurb: A burrowing, acid-spitting insect the size of a cart, dreaded by farmers and prized by armourers for its shell.

harvest.note: Split along the seams; prying at the plates cracks them.
Rupture it (fail by 5+) and take a splash of acid.

monsters.name: Basilisk
monsters.blurb: An eight-legged reptile whose gaze turns flesh to stone; its lair is ringed with the statues of careless hunters.

harvest.note: Harvest blindfolded or by mirror; a direct look at a fresh eye can still stiffen your limbs (Constitution save).
Collect it before it clots into sand.
A faint shimmer over the body marks it. Catch it in an Essence Vessel within a minute.

monsters.name: Behir
monsters.blurb: A many-legged, serpentine storm-beast that spits lightning and hates dragons; its lightning gland is a smith's treasure.

harvest.note: Discharge the gland with an iron rod first or take the leftover charge (lightning damage).
A faint shimmer over the body marks it. Catch it in an Essence Vessel within a minute.

monsters.name: Centaur
monsters.blurb: A proud horse-bodied people of the wild plains; they are not prey — only their gear may be recovered, and honourably.

harvest.note: Returning a fallen centaur's bow to its herd earns their lasting friendship.

monsters.name: Chimera
monsters.blurb: A three-headed horror of lion, goat and dragon; each head offers a very different trophy.

harvest.note: Handle with tongs; a jolt makes it vent a gout of flame.
Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute of death, or it's gone.

monsters.name: Chuul
monsters.blurb: A crustacean horror guarding ancient ruins; its face-tentacles paralyse prey and its shell is aquatic armour.

harvest.note: Wear gloves; brushing them bare risks paralysis (Constitution save).
A faint shimmer over the body marks it. Catch it in an Essence Vessel within a minute.

monsters.name: Cloaker
monsters.blurb: A manta-shaped predator that mimics a cloak and moans to drive prey mad; its hide is the finest shadow-leather known.

harvest.note: Must be flayed in darkness; exposure to bright light before curing makes it brittle.
Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute of death, or it's gone.

monsters.name: Cockatrice
monsters.blurb: A bad-tempered rooster-lizard whose bite slowly turns flesh to stone.

harvest.note: Scrape the ducts without breaking skin, or risk stiffening joints (Constitution save).
Only in a nest; about one in three is fertile.
Needs an Essence Vessel within 1 minute of death; leave the stopper off and the glass slowly greys to stone.

monsters.name: Darkmantle
monsters.blurb: A cave-ceiling ambusher that drops onto prey and smothers it in magical darkness.

harvest.note: Pops if squeezed carelessly, filling the area with darkness for a minute.

monsters.name: Death Dog
monsters.blurb: A two-headed hound of the wastes whose bite carries a wasting sickness.

harvest.note: Boil before handling; nicking yourself risks the wasting disease.
Collect with a bone scoop; a failed check (by 5+) exposes you to its disease.

monsters.name: Doppelganger
monsters.blurb: A grey, featureless shapeshifter that steals faces and secrets; its body is the stuff of disguise magic.

harvest.note: Keep it in darkness; once it sets into a random face, its magic fades.
A faint shimmer over the body marks it. Catch it in an Essence Vessel within a minute.

monsters.name: Drider
monsters.blurb: A cursed drow fused with a giant spider; its silk and its poisoned drow weapons are both prized.

harvest.note: Milk the fangs into a vial before the jaw stiffens.
Salvage from its gear; handle the edge only by the grip.
Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute of death, or it's gone.

monsters.name: Ettercap
monsters.blurb: A spider-keeping forest hag-thing whose silk glands make the strongest webbing in the woods.

harvest.note: Gathered from the lair; burning debris ruins it.

monsters.name: Gibbering Mouther
monsters.blurb: A heaving mass of eyes and mouths whose endless babble fractures sanity.

harvest.note: Listening too long while cutting risks a bout of short madness.
It escapes with the last breath: hold an Essence Vessel ready and stopper it within a minute.

monsters.name: Gorgon
monsters.blurb: A bull of iron plates whose breath turns everything to stone; its hide is armour and its lungs a weapon.

harvest.note: Seal it in wax before transport; a rupture releases a petrifying cloud.
Requires a hacksaw or smith's tools to pry the plates free.
It escapes with the last breath: hold an Essence Vessel ready and stopper it within a minute.

monsters.name: Grick
monsters.blurb: A worm-bodied ambusher with a beaked, tentacled head, colored to match cave stone.

monsters.name: Griffon
monsters.blurb: An eagle-headed lion of the high peaks; trained as mounts, but its feathers are prized too.

harvest.note: Must be kept warm; worth far more alive than cooked.

monsters.name: Guardian Naga
monsters.blurb: A wise, serpentine guardian of holy places that spits venom and returns from death unless cleansed.

harvest.note: Spit can still spray in a death reflex; wear a mask.
Removing it without holy rites draws the naga's vengeance upon rebirth.
It escapes with the last breath: hold an Essence Vessel ready and stopper it within a minute.

monsters.name: Gynosphinx
monsters.blurb: A lion-bodied sphinx of riddles and prophecy; slaying one is sacrilege, but its shed feathers and gifts are priceless.

harvest.note: Only shed or given feathers work — plucked ones are dull and ordinary.
Only from a sphinx that died of natural causes or in honourable duel.
Given freely in grief or for a riddle answered; cannot be taken.
A faint shimmer over the body marks it. Catch it in an Essence Vessel within a minute.

monsters.name: Harpy
monsters.blurb: A vulture-winged hag whose sweet song lures sailors and travellers to their deaths.

harvest.note: Extremely fragile; a clumsy cut (fail by 5+) snaps them.
Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute of death, or it's gone.

monsters.name: Hippogriff
monsters.blurb: A horse-bodied, eagle-fronted flyer; easier to tame than a griffon and plentiful on high meadows.

monsters.name: Hydra
monsters.blurb: A many-headed swamp serpent that grows two heads for each one severed; only fire stops its flesh from regrowing.

harvest.note: Still beats after death; keep it in brine or it tries to regrow tissue around itself.
Cauterise each cut with fire within a minute, or a writhing new head-bud begins to grow.
A faint shimmer over the body marks it. Catch it in an Essence Vessel within a minute.

monsters.name: Kraken
monsters.blurb: A leviathan squid of the abyssal trenches that calls storms and drags fleets to their doom.

harvest.note: The ink sac must be drained in the water; out of it the sac bursts.
Each takes a team of workers a full day to cut and salt.
Draw the lingering charge before cutting or you're struck by lightning.
A faint shimmer over the body marks it. Catch it in an Essence Vessel within a minute.

monsters.name: Lamia
monsters.blurb: A lion-bodied temptress of desert ruins who weaves illusions and saps the wisdom of those it touches.

harvest.note: Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute of death, or it's gone.

monsters.name: Manticore
monsters.blurb: A man-faced, bat-winged lion that looses volleys of tail spikes at its prey.

monsters.name: Medusa
monsters.blurb: A cursed, snake-haired recluse whose gaze turns onlookers to stone; its head is a legendary trophy.

harvest.note: Behead and bag it by mirror alone; its eyes still petrify for 1 hour after death.
Harvest blindfolded or by mirror only.
The hair-snakes may still bite for a minute after death.
Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute of death, or it's gone.

monsters.name: Merrow
monsters.blurb: A brutish, harpoon-wielding sea-ogre corrupted by demonic worship.

monsters.name: Mimic
monsters.blurb: A shapeshifting ambusher that poses as chests and doors, gluing victims fast with its adhesive skin.

harvest.note: Scrape it with wooden tools; metal sticks fast and is lost.
A faint shimmer over the body marks it. Catch it in an Essence Vessel within a minute.

monsters.name: Minotaur
monsters.blurb: A bull-headed labyrinth dweller that never loses its way and charges with devastating force.

harvest.note: Saw at the base; cracking the core loses the sense-of-direction virtue.
A faint shimmer over the body marks it. Catch it in an Essence Vessel within a minute.

monsters.name: Otyugh
monsters.blurb: A filth-eating sewer horror whose bite spreads sickness — yet its body resists every disease.

harvest.note: The stench forces a Constitution save or you're poisoned for an hour.
Pull them with tongs and boil them before bare hands touch them; the crust carries the otyugh's disease.
A faint shimmer over the body marks it. Catch it in an Essence Vessel within a minute.

monsters.name: Owlbear
monsters.blurb: A hulking, owl-headed bear of the deep woods, beloved by trophy hunters.

harvest.note: Nests are guarded; take them only when the parents are gone.

monsters.name: Phase Spider
monsters.blurb: A giant spider that blinks in and out of the Ethereal Plane; its silk slips between worlds.

harvest.note: Gather from the web while the spider is visible; sometimes strands phase away as you collect them.
Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute of death, or it's gone.

monsters.name: Purple Worm
monsters.blurb: A colossal burrowing worm that swallows prey whole; its tail venom is the most famous poison in the world.

harvest.note: Milk the tail stinger slowly; rupture the sac (fail by 5+) and you're exposed to its full poison.
Sift through first — gullets often hold swallowed treasure and armour.
A faint shimmer over the body marks it. Catch it in an Essence Vessel within a minute.

monsters.name: Remorhaz
monsters.blurb: A glacier-burrowing centipede whose back glows red-hot; its heat gland is a forge in a sac.

harvest.note: Wait for the back plates to cool from white-hot before cutting, or take fire damage.
It escapes with the last breath: hold an Essence Vessel ready and stopper it within a minute.

monsters.name: Roc
monsters.blurb: A bird so vast it carries off elephants; a single feather could sail a boat.

harvest.note: Nests are high on peaks; parents are never far.
Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute of death, or it's gone.

monsters.name: Roper
monsters.blurb: A stalagmite-shaped cave predator with adhesive strands that sap strength.

harvest.note: Cut near the base while the roper is still; live strands drag you in.
It escapes with the last breath: hold an Essence Vessel ready and stopper it within a minute.

monsters.name: Rust Monster
monsters.blurb: An armoured, insectoid metal-eater whose antennae rust iron on contact.

harvest.note: Use bone or wooden tools only — metal blades rust instantly.
Needs an Essence Vessel within 1 minute of death; use a glass or wax stopper, as it rusts a metal cap shut.

monsters.name: Spirit Naga
monsters.blurb: A cruel, necromantic serpent that returns from death unless its body is destroyed.

harvest.note: Destroy it in holy fire or keep it under consecrated seal; the naga returns if it's left intact.
Seal it in an Essence Vessel within a minute of death, or it's gone.

monsters.name: Tarrasque
monsters.blurb: The world-ending engine of destruction; its reflective carapace turns aside spells, and every part is legendary.

harvest.note: Requires adamantine tools and days of work per plate.
Must be pierced and drained; while beating, it regenerates the tarrasque if not destroyed.
A faint shimmer over the body marks it. Catch it in an Essence Vessel within a minute.

monsters.name: Winter Wolf
monsters.blurb: A cunning, speaking wolf of the frozen north that breathes freezing wind.

harvest.note: Skin in one piece; the pelt loses its magic if torn.
Can still exhale a frost burst for an hour after death.
It escapes with the last breath: hold an Essence Vessel ready and stopper it within a minute.

monsters.name: Worg
monsters.blurb: A malevolent, intelligent wolf that serves goblins as a mount.
